newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly higher in OTC trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly higher in OTC trade.

text.p: Following is the closing report for Croatia's over-the-counter securities market in Varazdin including its outpost Osijek for Wednesday, October 2.
* Ten of 16 traded issues rose, one fell and five were flat.
* 10-stock VIN index up 0.08 percent to 7,766 points.
* Most active Croatia Banka down 5.0 percent to 38 marks a share on volume of 1,606.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Jadran Crikvenica, up 87.50 percent to 150 marks with 26 shares sold, followed by:
- Hoteli Rabac, up 51.89 pct (from early in April) to 30 marks a share on volume of 79 units
- Shipper Tankerska Plovidba, up 9.09 pct to 60 marks on volume of 105
- Jadranhoteli Rijeka, up 8.70 pct to 25 marks with 83 shares sold (last traded in May)
- Confectioner Kras, selling 200 shares, up 6.25 pct to 170 marks
- Cables maker Elka, up 5.77 pct to 55 marks on volume of 470
- Food processor Podravka, adding 2.74 pct to 75 marks with 762 shares traded
- Textile firm Varteks, up 2.63 pct to 19.50 marks on volume of 1,077
- Hotelier Laguna, up 1.92 pct to 265 marks with 39 shares sold
- Varazdinska Banka, selling 40 units, up 0.80 pct to 126 marks.
* Unchanged:
- Hotelier Riviera at 45 marks with 1,006 shares sold and Arenaturist at 40 marks on volume of 430
- Adriatic pipeline operator Jadranski Naftovod at 580 marks on volume of 10
- Dalmatinska Banka at 900 marks with two shares sold (last traded in April)
* Volume 6,087 shares, turnover 306,274 German marks.
-- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
